name: Extrapolations
description: Eight interconnected stories told over 33 years explore how our planet’s changing climate will affect family, work, faith—and survival.

videos.title: 2037: A Raven Story
videos.overview: As nations fight over Earth’s fate, Rebecca, Marshall, and Junior all see their plans go up in smoke.

videos.title: 2046: Whale Fall
videos.overview: Rebecca, a marine biologist, strives to connect with a humpback whale before it’s too late.

videos.title: 2047: The Fifth Question
videos.overview: As Miami’s waters rise, Rabbi Zucker gets an intriguing offer from the father of a young woman preparing for her bat mitzvah.

videos.title: 2059: Face of God
videos.overview: Jonathan suspects his ex-wife’s latest invention—a pilotless, solar-powered plane—isn’t what it seems.

videos.title: 2059 Part II: Nightbirds
videos.overview: In Mumbai, small-time criminal Gaurav and his unexpected companion Neel must complete a high-stakes mission.

videos.title: 2066: Lola
videos.overview: Natasha, a single mom in London, braves the world of artificial companionship, until she rents a partner she can't forget.

videos.title: 2068: The Going-Away Party
videos.overview: Auggie and Sylvie throw an intimate New Year's Eve party where he makes a surprise announcement.

videos.title: 2070: Ecocide
videos.overview: Nicholas Bilton is on trial for crimes against the planet, but will the new Alpha CEO save him—and the world?
